# awscc_networkfirewall_container_association (Data Source)

Data Source schema for AWS::NetworkFirewall::ContainerAssociation



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.

### Read-Only

- `container_association_arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the container association.
- `container_association_name` (String) The descriptive name of the container association. You can't change the name of a container association after you create it.
- `container_monitoring_configurations` (Attributes Set) The monitoring configurations for the container association. Each configuration specifies an Amazon ECS or Amazon EKS cluster to monitor and optional attribute filters to narrow which containers are tracked. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--container_monitoring_configurations))
- `description` (String) A description of the container association.
- `resolved_cidr_count` (Number) The number of CIDR blocks resolved from the monitored containers.
- `status` (String) The current status of the container association.
- `tags` (Attributes Set) An array of key-value pairs to apply to this resource. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))
- `type` (String) The type of containers to monitor. You can't change the container type after creation.

<a id="nestedatt--container_monitoring_configurations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `container_monitoring_configurations`

Read-Only:

- `attribute_filters` (Attributes Set) Key-value pairs that filter which containers are tracked. For Amazon EKS, you can filter by namespace and Kubernetes labels. For Amazon ECS, you can filter by container instance attributes (EC2 launch type only). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--container_monitoring_configurations--attribute_filters))
- `cluster_arn` (String) The ARN of the Amazon ECS or Amazon EKS cluster to monitor. The cluster must be in the same Region and account as the container association.

<a id="nestedatt--container_monitoring_configurations--attribute_filters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `container_monitoring_configurations.attribute_filters`

Read-Only:

- `key` (String) The attribute key to filter on.
- `value` (String) The attribute value to match.



<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tags`

Read-Only:

- `key` (String) The part of the key:value pair that defines a tag. Tag keys are case-sensitive.
- `value` (String) The part of the key:value pair that defines a tag. Tag values are case-sensitive.
